parts:
Your Shiny application should not be installing packages itself.

Install your packages locally, and the application should just have library calls.

On Tuesday, January 30, 2018 at 11:43:14 AM UTC-5, Denis Coutrot wrote:
Hello Joshua,

I have a problem with uploading my app. I do not really understand what the log says. It seems that one package failed to install but I do not understand which one.
Thank you.

Denis
